summary: Set up staging deployment infrastructure with password protection. Created .env.example for environment configuration, src/.htaccess with HTTP Basic Authentication, deploy.sh script supporting rsync/scp/ftp deployment methods, added deploy npm scripts to package.json, updated .eleventy.js to pass through .htaccess to build output, added .htpasswd to .gitignore, and created docs/STAGING_ACCESS.md with stakeholder access instructions. Build verified successfully with all pages and assets generating correctly.
